meta.name: The Tire Plug — Knockout (auto-reject) Questions
meta.how_it_works: These are hard yes/no requirements asked BEFORE the situational survey. A 'failing' answer auto-rejects the applicant (status='rejected_knockout') and skips AI grading entirely - so an obvious bad fit never reaches the owner's dashboard. Tune the requirements here without touching code.
meta.rejection_message: Thanks for your interest in The Tire Plug. Based on your answers, this role isn't the right fit right now - but we appreciate you taking the time.

questions.label: Do you have reliable transportation to get to work every scheduled day?
Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
Are you 18 years of age or older?
Our shop is open 7 days a week, including weekends. Are you available to work weekends?
This is a physical job: standing all day and lifting up to 50 lbs (tires, wheels). Can you do that?
Are you willing to complete a background and/or drug screen if offered the position?
